howToPlay: Use your range to control the map and push back enemies with your Super. Deploy gadgets like Spring Ejector or Twister to reposition your team or block enemy paths.
gears: Equip SPEED and HEALTH to improve your movement and survivability. DAMAGE and SHIELD are also great choices for enhancing your impact in combat.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical area control and disrupting enemy movement.
